reason: Domestic single-unit finished protected pack; 300mA continuous rating and 300mAh capacity remove the former 50mA custom-pack bottleneck. Requires larger case, PH connector and independent contact temperature sensor. Not yet electrically qualified.

manufacturer_evidence.polarity: Drawing shows red positive and black negative; mating header pad numbering requires separate manufacturer drawing alignment.
manufacturer_evidence.drawing_error: Pack illustration says 3000mAh; section 3.1 and 3.2 both say 300mAh. Do not use label typo as capacity.

alternatives.decision: Smaller fallback;110mA ceiling, undocumented NTC R-T and tighter runtime budget remain. Existing3pin header fits nominal pinout but not current tiny case.

runtime_caveat: Assumed battery-side whole-system currents. Exact card/CPU duty cycle and capacity above LDO dropout not measured; 16h remains a target. At60% usable capacity the16h budget is11.25mA.
